page.layout: One page of text, one column. Title block at the top (large heading, page number above it). Then an introductory paragraph with a drop cap. Then a centred section heading, followed by a two-column list of titles and page numbers, with the list continuing at the foot where a catchword appears.

main_text.head: INDEX TITULORUM TRIUM-PHI BIBLICI.
main_text.p: TRes sunt veluti sectiones huius triumphi Biblici. Pri-ma ordine explicat quatuor facultates, philosophiā, theologiam, iurisprudentiam, & medicinam. Secunda exhibet particulas facultatum & disciplinarum liberalium. Tertia proponit illos titulos, qui sunt veluti farra-go plurium facultatum & artium.
main_text.head: I. FACVLTATES QVATVOR.
main_text.l: IX. Physica, sub quā continentur Physica generalis, Phy-
